page.overview:
Who is Bruan?

Bruan, known also as The Durasteel Fist, was a male Human who served the Sith Empire during the Cold War. During the War, he was stationed in the Imperial Intelligence Gadget Warehouse on the moon Nar Shaddaa where he was killed by Galactic Republic aligned individuals.
